title: Marriage License and Certificate — S. E. Arterberry and Martha L. Buford, Fannin County, Texas, 1897
text:
STATE OF TEXAS,
FANNIN COUNTY.

To any Judge of the County or District Court Regularly Licensed or Ordained
Minister of the Gospel, Jewish Rabbi or Justice of the Peace in and for said County of
FANNIN —
GREETING:
YOU ARE HEREBY AUTHORIZED TO SOLEMNIZE THE

RITES OF MATRIMONY

Between Mr. S. E. Arterberry
and Miss Martha L. Buford
and make due return to the Clerk of the County Court of said
County within forty days thereafter certifying your action
under this License.
WITNESS my official signature and seal of
office at office in Bonham this 7th
day of June, A.D. 1897.
[Signed:] J. Bradlee[?]
Deputy  Clerk County Court Fannin County Texas

I, J. H. Lawson, a Christian[?] preacher[?],
hereby certify that on the 7th day of June A.D. 1897
united in Marriage Mr. S. E. Arterberry
and Miss Martha L. Buford, the parties here named.
Witness my hand this 7th day of June, A.D. 1897.
Christian Preacher
J. H. Lawson
notes: Marriage license issued from Bonham (county seat of Fannin County) authorizing solemnization of marriage between S. E. Arterberry and Martha L. Buford. The officiating minister J. H. Lawson signed as 'Christian Preacher.' Deputy clerk's surname is difficult to read — possibly Bradlee or similar. Document is a printed form with handwritten entries.
